stem:
Bilal's grandmother cooks the same dal on a wood fire. His uncle cooks it on a gas stove in a modern kitchen.

Which claims correctly describe these cooking practices? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: These practices can differ because culinary practices change over time.
Any difference is only personal taste, never change over time.
Traditional and modern cooking practices can show significant differences.
This is only a wood-versus-gas label, not a traditional-versus-modern difference.

teacher.key_rationale: Cooking practices change over time, so a wood-fire method and a modern gas stove can differ as traditional versus modern culinary practices. The difference is not only personal taste, and it is not merely a surface wood-versus-gas label.
